decisions.reason: The spring-controlled flap weir sits close to the firm's core hydraulic steel engineering business for flood control, and such long-lifecycle infrastructure products are rarely withdrawn only a year after launch.

An energy management system for water facilities fits the firm's strategic push toward digital networking and energy efficiency, so it is likely to be developed further rather than dropped, even though it is only mentioned on the website.
The overflow flap gate line has several models and its own web page, which signals a committed core product in water level regulation that municipalities and utilities need for many years.
